theme_central: Divine redefinition of "victory": the treaty of Hudaybiyya, perceived as a setback by some companions, is proclaimed a "clear victory".

branches.title: Clear victory
branches.resume: The treaty of Hudaybiyya proclaimed a clear victory, forgiveness of the Prophet's past and future faults.

children.t: Clear victory proclaimed, forgiveness granted to the Prophet

branches.title: The Sakinah, allegiance to the Prophet
branches.resume: Punishment of the hypocrites and idolaters, inner peace (sakinah) sent down upon the believers.

children.t: Punishment of the hypocrites, the sakinah, allegiance to the Prophet equal to allegiance to Allah

branches.title: Excuses of the desert Arabs
branches.resume: Cowardice and bad faith of the desert Arabs who stayed behind, their doubt about the Prophet's truthfulness.

children.t: Excuses of the desert Arabs who stayed behind, their bad faith exposed

branches.title: Future victories, vision confirmed
branches.resume: Promise of spoils, future victories (Khaybar), pact under the tree, the Prophet's vision confirmed.

children.t: Promise of spoils and future victories, pact under the tree (bay'at ar-ridwan)
Vision confirmed: entry into the Sacred Mosque

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Description of the Prophet's companions in the Torah and the Gospel.

children.t: Description of the Prophet's companions, firm toward the disbelievers, merciful among themselves
